title: Publish validated findings to Agora servants and show them as Trading Room system suggestions (Design §12.7)

covers: AC1 Validated attribution findings, endorsed lessons, and validated strategy facts are read from their owners as institutional facts with links to the attribution record and validation result
AC2 An Agora servant reads them read-only and the Trading Room returns the ones relevant to the trader's current decision as system suggestions with evidence and nothing executes
AC3 Hypotheses that are unvalidated or recorded as luck_or_unsupported are never returned as suggestions
AC4 HTTP tests cover a relevant validated finding, an unvalidated one, and an owner outage with the owners doubled at their HTTP edges
In-process integration against real services.research.main.app and services.memory.main.app with C3 attribution contract double
Agora servant status and research proposal regression suite
Agora shadow mode and Trading Room aggregate schema regression suite
BFF test architecture gate (no services.control_plane.bff.main import, no sys.path mutation)
Normalized route uniqueness and Agora router wiring gate
